Name: Auidya Slash
Description:
You brandish the sword used in the spell's casting and make a ranged spell attack with it against one creature within 60 feet of you, releasing a shadowy slash that flies towards the target. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and an additional 1d6 Psychic damage.

Furthermore, they must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or suffer an effect of your choice. Either the Blinded Condition as your shadows engulf their face or to have a condition removed from them as your shadows absorb it. If the Condition has multiple counts, you remove a number of counts equal to double the spell slot spent to cast this.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can choose between the damage dice increasing or decreasing by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.
